hooks.command:
BRANCH=$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>/dev/null); [ "$BRANCH" != "main" ] && exit 0; LAST_TAG=$(git describe --tags --abbrev=0 2>/dev/null || echo ""); if [ -z "$LAST_TAG" ]; then COMMITS=$(git rev-list HEAD --count 2>/dev/null || echo "0"); else COMMITS=$(git rev-list "${LAST_TAG}..HEAD" --count 2>/dev/null || echo "0"); fi; [ "$COMMITS" -eq "0" ] && exit 0; NEXT=$(echo "$LAST_TAG" | sed 's/^v//' | awk -F. '{print $1"."$2"."$3+1}'); printf '{"systemMessage":"%s unreleased commit(s) since %s. Prepare release v%s:
  1. Bump versions in plugin.json, marketplace.json, .release-please-manifest.json
  2. Update CHANGELOG.md
  3. git tag v%s && git push origin v%s
  4. gh release create v%s --title v%s --notes ..."}
' "$COMMITS" "$LAST_TAG" "$NEXT" "$NEXT" "$NEXT" "$NEXT" "$NEXT"
